ambient_events: Somebody tries the door handle from the street, looks through the whitewash, and moves on.
The extractor housing in the ceiling ticks as it cools, though nothing has been running.
A studio van reverses past the window, its warning tone flattening through the glass.
The letting notice on the inside of the window peels another centimetre from the tape.
description: A long, narrow retail unit stripped back to the render. There's a counter, bolted down so it stayed, a run of empty shelving along one wall, and a floor safe sunk into the concrete at the back with its door hanging open. It was a print room for thirty years; the ceiling still carries the ammonia stain and the extractor housing nobody could get out. Through the whitewashed glass, the studio crowd goes past in both directions all day long.

window.description: A window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window
